description: Figure 5 presents a bar chart illustrating the average entropy across different source types. The horizontal axis displays the source type categories: “Baseline”, “Direct Command”, “Source Info”, and “Source Sync”, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Four bars are displayed, one for each source type. The “Baseline” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 0.8. The “Direct Command” bar is dark blue and reaches a height of approximately 0.4. The “Source Info” bar is a lighter shade of blue and extends to approximately 1.1. Finally, the “Source Sync” bar is the darkest blue and reaches the maximum value of 1.2. The bars are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and no additional annotations are present.
